taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: SSO just-in-time organization and role assignment
controls.source_trace: Follow issuer-controlled and user-controlled attributes into organization selection and role grants. Determine which IdPs are trusted for which tenant authority.
controls.implementation_branch: An email-domain string is not necessarily verified domain control. Establish which issuer is trusted to assert which organization and role. Existing-user account linking and new-user JIT admission are distinct transitions; accepting a new low-privilege user does not prove administrative membership or existing-account takeover.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned tenants/IdPs with a controlled domain or role collision and inspect resulting membership/capabilities server-side.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Creating an ordinary account through an allowed IdP is expected; a domain string without a granted membership is not tenant takeover.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain issuer-to-tenant/role mappings and retest authorized JIT entry and unauthorized membership assignment.
